The ZNF835 `molWeight` field in UniProtKB is clearly corrupted (9 × 10⁹ Da ≈ 15,000× too large). The sequence itself is valid: 537 residues, all standard amino acids, consistent CRC64/MD5, and its amino-acid composition (Cys-rich, His-rich C2H2 zinc-finger signature) is biologically sensible. Recomputing from the sequence gives 59.63 kDa, which is consistent with 537 aa (~110 Da/residue). AHCYL2's 66,721 Da matches its recomputed 66,720 Da exactly, so the comparison rests on solid ground: AHCYL2 is heavier by ~7.1 kDa.
